properties.description:
Create ~/.TheBroccoli as a local Git repository on genuine first setup, with a TypeScript private-space script and a Broccoli buildspace containing exactly the Broccoli and private-space repositories. Reuse customisations thereafter; keep user data outside the source repository.

Implementation progress: Default owns the typed private-space script contract, first-use Git initialization and a receipt distinguishing first use from a missing established repository. The actual application entry now uses ~/.TheBroccoli/data and the configured initial buildspaces; Perso profile storage and query storage follow the user runtime directory. Existing repositories/scripts are preserved. Unit tests pass for creation, edits, stale-write rejection, broken scripts and missing repositories. The real composition-root startup test passes: exactly Broccoli + Private repositories, renamed runtime data survives restart, and broken script enters independent recovery. Remaining integration: dynamic space labels/membership and the final startup/composition checkpoint.

Slice verification completed: The composition-root startup recording verifies two initial repositories, user storage outside the checkout, preservation of live changes across restart, and independent recovery on script failure. Private-space unit tests verify exclusive creation and stale-write rejection.
